run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the smallest difference between angles of two parts of a given circle
test_f_gold: test f_gold with an array of angles and count n to verify correct output
review_f_gold: review f_gold sliding window algorithm that tracks running sum and finds minimum angle difference from 180 degrees
